detail: Mobius quote pages load in 1.54s for 3 in 4 views. Core has no timing data. Linked principles: design for observability; build for resiliency. Source: LogRocket, known live customers, last 3 months.

requirement: Quotes save and price without failing
baseline: 38% of quote sessions hit a failed request
detail: 38% of quote sessions hit at least one failed request, including background calls. Cat A history includes quoting failures. Linked principles: reduce the blast radius; build for resiliency. Source: LogRocket.

baseline: 89% of started quotes reach a summary
detail: 89% of new business quotes reach a quote summary in the same session; 27% go on to start conversion. Source: LogRocket Key Journey Metrics.

baseline: Slow document download in about 1,300 sessions a quarter
detail: The amended-document download is one of the three most common Mobius issues (about 1,300 sessions in 3 months). Bug guidance treats 'cannot download documents' as high priority. Source: LogRocket Platform Health; Mobius wiki bug priority.
80% of MTA quotes reach confirmation (median 48s). MTA also has the highest failure rate (46% of sessions) and failed under load at 100 users in 2024. Source: LogRocket; Mobius wiki load tests.

baseline: 90% of searches lead to a next step
detail: 90% of searches lead to opening a record, quoting or creating a client. Includes new clients, so it overstates finding existing records. Source: LogRocket.

baseline: 0.15 serious (Category A) tickets per 1,000 Mobius transactions
detail: Category A means unavailable, severely degraded or harming the customer's business; covered 7am to 9pm seven days a week. Mobius 0.15 per 1,000 transactions vs Core 0.012. Source: Power BI Customer Compass; Mobius wiki.
